info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Utility Billing Autopays-v4-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Autopay Retrieval API provides access to a comprehensive list of autopay records for utility billing. This endpoint allows users to retrieve relevant details regarding automated payment setups, enhancing the management of billing processes. Typically utilized by utility companies and billing administrators, it facilitates auditing and reporting tasks, ensuring that customers can efficiently monitor their autopay status. The API streamlines operations by providing essential information necessary for effective billing management.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve their current billing autopay settings, providing information about the status and any applicable configurations.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving autopay settings, allowing the user to configure or check their billing preferences.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the current autopay settings.
